name: Rosso di Cerignola

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A red wine from Puglia, made in Cerignola, Stornara and Stornarella. It is at least 55% Uva di Troia with 15 to 30% Negroamaro, and up to 15% in all of Sangiovese, Barbera, Montepulciano, Malbec or Trebbiano Toscano.
